usedFor: Razorpay takes payments, and Toggl Track gets a client when “Create a Client” follows “New Payment Captured”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Payment Captured” in Razorpay, then “Create a Client” in Toggl Track
bestTemplate.why: A captured payment adds the payer as a client, so you can log billable time against them.

watchOut: Each captured payment triggers a new client, so a repeat customer can end up added twice.
